notes.title: "Aeon of Sands" v1.5 released! - "New Game+" & 2 new Companions!
notes.content:
After 1.5 years, this is the release of [b]Aeon of Sands[/b] patch v1.5!

If you've finished the game at least once by reaching one of the three possible endings and start the game all over again, you can now skip the Tutorial Dungeon (the Underroots) and experience a new start to the adventure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33506852/82b0c8a9b1e2a2757dfcc231dfe30f585500250e.png[/img]

When you select the option to "skip the Underroots", two new characters are ready to join Setrani in Pantella right at the beginning to help him repeat his adventure.

[h2]Meet Tula and Kturim![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33506852/51263530c018232d8bc985c628cad69167a9040e.jpg[/img]

Besides Harro, you now have the extended choice between [b]Tula resilient scavenger[/b] or [b]Kturim a Berseker fighter[/b].

They speak little or not at all, but you can open up [b]new ways[/b] to explore and fight, and face new challenges!

Each of them comes with [b]a special item[/b] that offers you both normal and experimental combat modes, depending on whether the item is used or is rotting in the backpack.

[table]
    [tr]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33506852/09d0f42c5a415f7017d834bb8973e8e79540b6f6.jpg[/img][/td]
        [td]Tula, [b]a smart and resilient scavenger[/b], can use her technical skills to trick the magic out of the elements. So did the ancients in the tradition, but for the enormous price of their own health.

But Tula can also do without it and become a formidable ranged warrior.[/td]
    [/tr][tr]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33506852/d952676b66911d342fa20e881bc6017a53eea332.jpg[/img][/td]
        [td]Kturim, [b]a wise Berserk warrior[/b], can summon the power of a lost civilization with his scepter to attack from afar the ravenous beasts that plague the scorched desert.
Or he can lay down his scepter and stand before Setrani and be a true shield. This works even better when he is armed ;).[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]
What will you do, how will you decide?

[i]"Decisions and consequences. Why do you always have to play with me?"[/i]

[b]Let them accompany you while you explore a different path through Aeon of Sands![/b]

When you select the option to "skip the Underroots", two new characters are ready to join Setrani in Pantella right at the beginning to help him repeat his adventure.
Besides Harro, you now have the extended choice between [b]Tula resilient scavenger[/b] or [b]Kturim a Berseker fighter[/b].
They speak little or not at all, but you can open up [b]new ways[/b] to explore and fight, and face new challenges!
Each of them comes with [b]a special item[/b] that offers you both normal and experimental combat modes, depending on whether the item is used or is rotting in the backpack.

Tula, [b]a smart and resilient scavenger[/b], can use her technical skills to trick the magic out of the elements. So did the ancients in the tradition, but for the enormous price of their own health.
But Tula can also do without it and become a formidable ranged warrior.
Kturim, [b]a wise Berserk warrior[/b], can summon the power of a lost civilization with his scepter to attack from afar the ravenous beasts that plague the scorched desert.
Or he can lay down his scepter and stand before Setrani and be a true shield. This works even better when he is armed ;).
[b]Let them accompany you while you explore a different path through Aeon of Sands![/b]

notes.title: 100 Days of "Aeon of Sands" - Special Promotion Sale
notes.content:
[url= https://store.steampowered.com/app/907820/Aeon_of_Sands__The_Trail/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33506852/6da2e80237a89009730e50d32b8d7c83433eb10c.jpg[/img][/url]
To mark 100 days from the Aeon of Sands release, we’re doing a special promotion sale! The game is at [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/907820/Aeon_of_Sands__The_Trail/]30% discount[/url] from today until Monday 10am (US Pacific)!

[h1]Thanks to our wonderful community, in [b]100 days Aeon of Sands has become 100% better[/b]![/h1]

Here’s what we did:
[list]
[*] 6 patches released since December 4, 2018!
[*] improved bosses after feedback from players
[*] enhanced range combat and projectiles
[*] improved hard mode
[*] added the active-pause ability  to beginner mode
[*] game difficulty can be changed on the fly
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33506852/78dcc8d1003a40318777b19c6a964460a0c09307.png[/img]

AoS is now available on 5+ operating systems:
[list]
[*] Windows 7, 10
[*] macOS (10.12+)

[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33506852/dd114db70f316bdb666b7c8ec3b2acbfadd553f6.png[/img]
We remixed the sound of Aeon and released the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1025280/Aeon_of_Sands__Soundtrack/]Soundtrack with 22 amazing tracks[/url].

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33506852/06a41ec107ee8e2da4fa0e9c002b55f71a0efa7f.jpg[/img]
Marco created a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1025290/Aeon_of_Sands__Art_Book/]100 pages Art Book[/url] about the intriguing style of “Aeon of Sands”, together with lots of information about the influences, the story and the development

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/stats/907820/achievements][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33506852/538c29f6f979d2d1f0ad1f87b2f719f9578e40fd.png[/img][/url]

Yet, still 8 (of 24) achievements in the game have not been discovered! [h1]This means that a lot of branching story paths are still unrevealed in AoS! [/h1]This is a perfect time to join us in Aeon of Sands land, at a 30% discount!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/907820/Aeon_of_Sands__The_Trail/

[h1]So what can you expect in the next 100 days (give or take)?[/h1]

[b]Here’s our roadmap![/b]
[list]
[*] new game modes like Iron Man, Survival
[*] New Game+
[*] More gameplay stats
[*] Search for "The missing maze"
[*] make community translations possible (long term goal)
[*] …
[/list]

Thank you for your feedback, help and support!

Marco & Florian

notes.title: Aeon of Sands - Linux version is live!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33506852/78dcc8d1003a40318777b19c6a964460a0c09307.png[/img]

[h1]We are happy to announce the release of the [b]Linux[/b] version of [b]"Aeon of Sands"[/b].[/h1]

[h1]SteamOS + Linux[/h1]
Steam supported [b]Ubuntu 12.04 LTS/SteamOS[/b] and we could successfully test the game on it.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33506852/602f30ab375f59fe32082f16748f8c6e7a9dfae5.jpg[/img]

[h1]other distributions:[/h1]
Furthermore, we and some users have successfully tested the game on other Linux distributions as well. These include [u]Linux Manjaro (Arch) 64bit, Fedora Workstation 64bit and Linux Mint 64bit[/u]. However, this info is unofficial and we cannot provide any support here.

[h1]Steam Play/Proton[/h1]
If the game does not run on your Linux, you can also use [url=https://support.steampowered.com/kb_article.php?ref=9439-QHKN-1308&l=german]Steam Play[/url] or Proton to run the Windows version of the game on your Linux. Since this release also the Windows version should be compatible with Proton!

[h1]Window & macOS[/h1]
The Windows and MacOS versions of the game will also be updated to v1.081.

Have fun playing and please spread the word about the Linux version!

[u]Thank you for your support![/u]

TwoBitsKid^Marco & Florian

notes.title: Aeon of Sands - Huge Update (Version 1.0.8)
notes.content:
[h1]Version 1.0.8[/h1]

[h1]1. Bosses improved with new abilities![/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33506852/c0038c5d74abd5e1be7e3c9bf5210bf038002f62.jpg[/img]

[h1]2. Charges now shown on Icon![/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33506852/6606c9b5df00eba0fff7d750dad4d79a785683c7.png[/img]

[h1]3. Improved range weapons and projectiles![/h1]
[code]
'smallstone' 8 dmg + 'unmoveable' effect duration 0.1 + trait mod
'bolt' 14 dmg + 'unmoveable' effect duration 0.4 + trait mod
'flechette' 12 dmg + 'unmoveable' effect duration 0.3 + trait mod
'pellet' 20 dmg + 'unmoveable' effect duration 0.2 + trait mod
'stone' 3 dmg + 'unmoveable' effect duration 0.1 + trait mod
'splinteredstone' 6 dmg + 'unmoveable' effect duration 0.2 + trait mod
[/code]

[h1]4. The game's difficulty can now be changed on the fly during play![/h1]

[h1]5. Improved hard mode! Combat dance and hit&run is now much more difficult.[/h1]

[h1]6. Traits have levels now (just like in DM). They are shown in the character stats panel![/h1]
[code]
'Novice' 0-15%
'Beginner' 16-25%
'Competent' 26-45%
'Proficient' 46-65
'Expert' 66-85%
'Master' 86-100%
[/code]

[h1]7. Improved normal enemies. Resistances & Abilities added.[/h1]
[code]
Skeletons - invulnerable auran & elemental magic damage
CyberAnts - invulnerable auran damage
Rogue Thug - invulnerable auran damage
+Enemies that cast hide spell are now also permeable (no physical damage!)
and a lot more..!
[/code]

[h1]... and much more![/h1]

[h1]New Features:[/h1]
[list]
[*] 60   - visible 'charges' on Inventory Item Icons
[*] 1212 - change difficulty on the fly
[*] 1190 - PauseMode added to Beginner Mode (press Space to activate)

[*] 1459 - textbox comment added for spike damage, to better protect the feets
[*] 1440 - improve range weapons (cooldown reduced; and stun effect added to projectiles to make range combat more fun!)
[/list]

[h1]Corrections:[/h1]
[list]
1421 - Route on Worldmap from Valley to Fallen Dome disabled

notes.title: Aeon of Sands - Art Book | Soundtrack and support plan 2019
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33506852/d05ae5ebc16e70d354786967f2e19de5f364ff92.png[/img]

During the last month, we have been hard at work on the next patch for Aeon of Sands, which will introduce a number of fixes and improvements to the gameplay. We will also add some premium content to complete the package of the game.

[h1]Soundtrack[/h1]
You can expect 22 tracks for 35 minutes of great ambient and theme music. It's a direct, to the point collection, combining the exotic feelings of the desert of Aeon of Sands with those of a tense movie out of the 80’s.

[h1]Art Book[/h1]
Along with it, there will come a 100 pages Art Book of the game, brimful of cool artworks, including game production art and final illustration, in high resolution, complete with a bit of behind-the-scenes information, and an in detail article about the game inspiration.

All of the above is coming [b]early February[/b]!

[h1]Upcoming combat improvements:[/h1]
[list]
[*] NEW ability to change the difficulty of the game on the fly
[*] NEW easy/beginner mode gets an active pause (freezing time, but allowing you to consume health salves and reagents)
[*] Hard mode will be significantly harder, with quicker opponents and more difficult combat dance
[*] NEW “stun” effect added to projectiles (range combat)
[*] NEW strategies to bosses, making them more challenging
[*] Updates stats to range combat throughout all difficulty modes (range fighting is now more efficient and fun)
[*] Some normal enemies have learned resistance (i.e. skeletons are invulnerable to magic, and more...)
[/list]

There will also be improvements to other minor aspects: specific items, enemies etc. Overall, the game combat is less prone to feel mechanical and it feels more challenging and fun.

There are more things we are going to polish in our continuing support for Aeon of Sands. Suggestions are welcome!

notes.content:
[h1]Version 1.0.3[/h1]

[h1]New Features:[/h1]
[list]
[*] double-click (or middle-click) on an item in the inventory to identify items
(for touchpad/macOS users)
[*] hard mode is now even harder: enemy AI improved and chances to break an attack lowered
[*] the order of items in your inventory is now saved!
[*] you can now throw items into holes
[/list]

notes.title: Aeon of Sands - A post-apocalyptic RPG coming December 4, 2018
notes.content:
[b]Aeon of Sands - The Trail[/b] is a retro, post-apocalyptic RPG, set in a dangerously pixelated desert world that eats people, and has a taste for city clerks. - Oh, by the way, you are a city clerk. And it's lunch time.

Berlin, Germany - October 17, 2018. Two Bits Kid is proud to announce the release date of its upcoming game Aeon of Sands - The Trail, [b]coming on December 4, 2018[/b] for [b]Windows[/b] and [b]MacOS[/b].

Watch our Announcement Trailer:
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Isz3xdfjawY]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Isz3xdfjawY[/url]

[b]Features[/b]
- Extremely non-linear, replayable story with multiple endings
- Real-time combat
- 20 locations and more than 60 mazes and dungeons to explore
- More than 140 dialogues
- Completely hand-drawn 2.5D environment, 240 hand-drawn illustrations
- Up to 2 other characters can join your party during play
- Each character’s personality influences the outcome of the story, and opens up new paths

* [b]Platforms PC: Windows | MacOSX[/b]

[b]Available on December 4, 2018[/b]


[b]Aeon of Sands official site and socials[/b]
- Official site: [url=https://aeonofsands.com]https://aeonofsands.com[/url]
- Presskit: [url=https://presskit.aeonofsands.com/]https://presskit.aeonofsands.com/[/url]
- Blog: [url=http://blog.aeonofsands.com]http://blog.aeonofsands.com[/url]
- Fb: [url=https://www.facebook.com/aeonofsands]https://www.facebook.com/aeonofsands[/url]
- Twitter: [url=https://twitter.com/aeonofsands]https://twitter.com/aeonofsands[/url]
- Youtube: [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCv5pWton5kS8wIdSVqFY3mA]https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCv5pWton5kS8wIdSVqFY3mA[/url]


[b]Prerelease Press Coverage[/b]
https://www.rockpapershotgun.de/tag/aeon-of-sands
[i]“Der Dungeon-Crawler Aeon of Sands verspricht einen “Liebesbrief an die klassischen PC- und Amiga-Spiele der Neunziger...“[/i]

[i]“An incredible looking crawler that takes us back to the golden age of grid based crawlers...”[/i]
